      MEMORANDUM FOR: The Director of Central Intelligence 
SUBJECT : SKYLAB Imagery 25X1 
I. This note is to alert you and provide preliminary background 
information on an issue that might be raised by Secretary Rus# in your 
luncheon meeting today. 
  
    2. The issue arises from the fact that the recent SKYLAB mission 
inadvertently photographed| 25X1 There were specific instructions notto de this. [was the only 25X1   
location which had such an instruction. 
3. This photo has been going through an interagency reviewing 
process aimed at a decision on how it should be handled. There is no agreement. DoD elements (USAF, NRO, JCS, ISA, all believe it should 
be withheld from public release. NASA, ‘and to a large degree State, 
has taken the position that it should be released -- that is, allowed to 
go into the Souix Falls National Repository and to let nature take its course, 
4. A position paper containing these various views and 
providing recommendations for your action is being prepared and will 
be forwarded through Carl Duckett within a few days. (Positions of 
agencies have only now comein.) A preliminary draft version is 
attached for your advance information with regard to today's luncheon 
session. Most of the viewing officials up to this point feel that the final decision should be handled at an Agency head level. 
5. There are some complicated precedents which, in fairness, should be reviewed before a final decision, 
a. A question of whether anything photographed 
in the United States can be classified if the platform is 
unclassified.
